articles.title: South Korea's Education Minister Quits After Exam Cheating Scandal
articles.summary: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin quit after last-minute anti-cheating steps disrupted South Korea's huge college entrance exam.

articles.title: FBI Looks Into Possible Hack of Big Police Database
articles.summary: The FBI is looking into a possible hack of the National Crime Information Center, a database that police officers across the country use every day.

articles.title: Why a Week of Tech Failures Felt Like One Big Attack
articles.summary: A pileup of outages made many people suspect a coordinated attack, but experts say our pattern-seeking brains may be partly to blame.
